Given Clause: Given a new student on the registration page
When Clause: When they submit valid email username full name password and grade level
Then Clause: Then a student account is created with role student and an auth token is issued
Label: TARGET V1

When Clause: When they request another student's quiz attempt or profile
Then Clause: Then the API rejects the request with HTTP 403 Forbidden
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given an authenticated student without a completed profile
When Clause: When they enter the initial assessment and submit diagnostic answers
Then Clause: Then an assessment session is saved and diagnostic evidence is logged
Label: TARGET V1

When Clause: When the Learner Profile Service processes the assessment summary
Then Clause: Then a multidimensional Learner Profile document is created in learner_profiles
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given a student with low comprehension level
When Clause: When they ask the Chatbot a complex science question
Then Clause: Then the Chatbot response is adapted to simple vocabulary and guided steps
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given a student with topic mastery < 0.50 on fractions
When Clause: When they generate a fractions quiz
Then Clause: Then the quiz contains foundational questions with hints enabled
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given a student uploading a clear math homework image
Then Clause: Then text is extracted and step-by-step scaffolding is returned based on reading level
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given a student who completed a quiz
Then Clause: Then quiz stats and streak are updated dynamically from learning_events
Label: TARGET V1

Given Clause: Given a feature service requesting LLM text generation
When Clause: When the service calls AI Gateway generate_text()
Then Clause: Then the Gateway dispatches request to configured provider adapter without feature SDK calls
Label: TARGET V1
